scope: Replace this template with your own field: name the quantity you measure, the conditions you compare under, and what your study claims
checks: state how each variable is defined, in which unit, and in which coordinate or reference frame
record data source version, sampling pattern and quality flags before interpreting any value
separate observation, association and mechanism inference in every claim
record the baseline definition and its uncertainty; a sample standard deviation is not attribution evidence
do not hardcode specific dates, thresholds, amplitudes or any personal profile
